description: Energy totals from *_today counters. Use Grafana time picker only.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.component == "house" and r.metric == "energy_today")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "House" }))

from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.component == "pv" and r.metric == "energy_today")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Solar" }))

from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.component == "grid" and r.metric == "buy_today")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Import" }))

from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.component == "grid" and r.metric == "sell_today")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Export" }))

from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r.component == "battery" and (r.metric == "discharge_today" or r.metric == "charge_today")
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
        _field: "Battery",
        _value: if r.metric == "charge_today" then 0.0 - r._value else r._value
  }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Battery" }))

price = float(v: "${grid_price}")

from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.component == "grid" and r.metric == "buy_today")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: now(), _value: r._value * price }))
  |> yield(name: "Cost")

price = float(v: "${grid_price}")

from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      (r.component == "pv" and r.metric == "energy_today") or
      (r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "discharge_today") or
      (r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "charge_today")
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
        _field: "part",
        _value:
          if r.metric == "charge_today" then 0.0 - r._value
          else r._value
  }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _time: now(), _value: r._value * price }))
  |> yield(name: "Saving")

from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      (r.component == "pv" and r.metric == "energy_today") or
      (r.component == "grid" and r.metric == "buy_today") or
      (r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "discharge_today") or
      (r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "charge_today")
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with _field:
        if r.component == "pv" then "Solar"
        else if r.metric == "buy_today" then "Grid"
        else if r.metric == "discharge_today" then "Battery"
        else "Charge"
  }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with _value: if r._field == "Charge" then 0.0 - r._value else r._value
  }))
  |> yield(name: "energy")

from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      (r.component == "house" and r.metric == "energy_today") or
      (r.component == "pv" and r.metric == "energy_today") or
      (r.component == "grid" and r.metric == "buy_today") or
      (r.component == "grid" and r.metric == "sell_today") or
      (r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "charge_today") or
      (r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "discharge_today")
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with _field:
        if r.component == "house" then "Home"
        else if r.component == "pv" then "Solar"
        else if r.metric == "buy_today" then "Import"
        else if r.metric == "sell_today" then "Export"
        else if r.metric == "charge_today" then "Charge"
        else if r.metric == "discharge_today" then "Discharge"
        else r.component
  }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> yield(name: "dist")

from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")

  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "Solar" }))

from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "soc")
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: "SOC" }))

from(bucket: "solar_raw")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "solar" and r._field == "value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "${device}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      (r.component == "pv" and r.metric == "energy_today") or
      (r.component == "house" and r.metric == "energy_today") or
      (r.component == "grid" and r.metric == "buy_today") or
      (r.component == "grid" and r.metric == "sell_today") or
      (r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "charge_today") or
      (r.component == "battery" and r.metric == "discharge_today")
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with _field:
        if r.component == "house" then "Home"
        else if r.component == "pv" then "Solar"
        else if r.metric == "buy_today" then "Import"
        else if r.metric == "sell_today" then "Export"
        else if r.metric == "charge_today" then "Charge"
        else if r.metric == "discharge_today" then "Discharge"
        else r.component
  }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ Source: r._field, Energy: r._value }))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["Source"])
